resume: Tessera is a generative firmware: each of the four tracks plays its steps, an arpeggio or one of the thirteen generators, and the surrounding pages evolve the phrases, build forms and modulate everything from everything.

commandes.role: Octave down. With EDIT held, undo.
Octave up; on some pages, a displayed action. Held on GEN, the generator's second layer. With EDIT held, redo.
Insert and send effects. Held with a turned knob, sets that knob's modulation.
MODS, MATRIX, LFO, LFO 2, ORGANIC, LFO DEST pages.
Sound edit pages; on an edit page, the page map.
MIXER, GLOBAL, SYSTEM, MIDI OUT. Held, quick setting: black keys mute T1 to T4, white keys solo, F4 gives the tempo.
Home page of the four tracks; held, the menu.
USER, PROJECT, PRESETS pages; held, saves the project into its slot.
MODE and the ARP page; a second time, ARP 2. Held with a turned knob, the knob's help card.
GEN first (BOUTON 1 = MODE), then the pages of the track's mode. Held, PATTERNS.
Records; held, prints a generator's last bars into STEP.
Turns through the pages of the displayed section.
Chooses the track on all pages.

gestes: EDIT held + OCT- or OCT+: undo or redo.
SAVE + REC: saves the project into its slot.
a_savoir: A new project has no modulation: nothing moves until you patch some in.
